name: setup-manaflow-ai-codex-profile
description: Opt-in. One look built from the codex-app recipe and the four codex feature looks (composer, send-parity, sidebar, threads): the reference app's theme, system type at 12 pt, a 1200 pt transcript column, the round studio composer with circular icon buttons, a 340 pt sidebar of 11 pt one-line chats by project with a spinner or unread dot and Settled folding, a Chats section with New chat, Active work, Pinned, Projects, Recents, a sort and archive from a row, the thread hover card, the builder New Tab page ("What should we build in {project}?"), the app's keyboard shortcuts and fast, quiet motion. README.md lists every feature of the reference app and how this look matches it or which gap is left. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.themes/codex-app.json:
// The Codex app: a soft gray sidebar beside a white page, near-black text, gray accents, no
// borders, and the app's big round corners. Colors from the codex-app recipe
// (manaflow-ai/cmux#45804); edit and save, the window repaints at once.
{
  "name": "Codex app",
  "description": "A gray sidebar beside a white page, near-black text, big round corners, no borders.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  "colors": { "background": "#ffffff", "foreground": "#0d0d0d", "selection": "#e3e3e3", "cursor": "#0d0d0d", "accent": "#777777" },
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "appearance.accent": "neutral",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  // The sidebar and the accent a step lighter than the recipe's (#ececec, #5d5d5d), so the muted
  // captions of a selected row read at 4.5:1 (`cmux theme check`).
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#f9f9f9",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 0.94,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#ffffff",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "native",


  "appearance.density": "comfortable",

  // Shape, not only color (Leo: "customizing the tabs/sidebars a lot deeper"): Codex's big round corners: 14 pt tabs, 12 pt sidebar rows on a 300 pt sidebar in large text, Codex's sidebar look, the top right buttons always shown, Session Info over the chat.
  "density": { "basedOn": "comfortable", "tokens": {"tabCornerRadius": 14, "tabCloseCornerRadius": 8, "verticalTabCornerRadius": 12, "sidebarCornerRadius": 12, "itemCornerRadius": 12, "panelCornerRadius": 20, "sidebarWidth": 300, "sidebarRowHeight": 34, "sidebarRowGap": 2, "sidebarRowInset": 10, "tabGap": 6, "browserRowHeight": 32, "controlHeight": 30 } },
  "sidebar.look": "codex",
  "sidebar.textSize": "large",
  "appearance.cornerFlush": "off",
  "window.titlebarButtons": "always",
  "tabs.plusButton": "hover",
  "agentPane.display.sessionInfo.placement": "overlay"
}
